# Opt-in motion export.  When false nothing is written beyond
# evaluation/per_sequence_metrics.json and that payload carries no
# motion_export key, so an export-capable build reproduces a pre-export payload
# byte for byte.  When true, motion/<sequence_id>.npz is written next to it with
# global_jpos at the rollout rate (fps = fps / interp_s) for the frozen
# text-motion evaluator, plus the SMPL-X FK inputs so a later metric
# redefinition is a CPU rebuild instead of another GPU run.
export_motion: false

lingo_hsi_mode: ground_truth
lingo_sequence_limit: null

# Episode sharding for the quality pass.  shard_count=1 is the serial protocol
# and is the default; >1 splits the canonical episode enumeration by greedy
# longest-first bin packing over per-episode window counts, and invalidates
# every timing aggregate because the shards contend for the host.
# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gate, default OFF so the sealed path is bitwise unchanged.
# test_infbagel_hosi.sample_step zeroes `pi` inside `if is_loco:` but leaves `end_pi`,
# so the model receives end_pi - pi = 42*step + 48 while training carries
# min(pi + 16*3, seq_len) i.e. exactly 48 on 517,484 of 529,132 need_pi windows.
# Only step 0 is training-legal: 375 of 2271 eval windows (16.5%).
# true = keep the true pi, restoring end_pi - pi == 48 on every window.
hsi_progress_fix: false

# hsi_guidance_norm_cap: per-step trust region on the guidance increment, applied on
# the DIFFUSION path only (Sampler.p_sample); the consistency path is untouched.
# null = off, and the arithmetic emitted is byte-identical to the released path -- no
# norm is computed and no extra tensor op runs.  A float caps the increment's PER-SAMPLE
# L2 norm: gradient *= min(1, cap / (||gradient|| + 1e-12)).
# It exists because the matched 2x2 of 2026-08-23 attributed 100% of the physically
# impossible root accelerations to guidance -- 132 frames over 5g in B v2 guided and 41
# in C v2 guided against 0 in both unguided cells -- and 80.2% of the summed effect
# magnitude on boundary_jerk to guidance-involving terms, with the interaction (64.401)
# the largest single term.  The released sampler adds the increment unnormalised once
# per sampler step, 499 times per window against the consistency path's 16.
# Units are those of the normalised 232-channel x_start, so a threshold is only
# meaningful relative to a measured increment distribution; see
# docs/plan/PHASE_1C_HSI.md 2026-08-23 SS-H.
hsi_guidance_norm_cap: null

# The two DOSE knobs, both off by default and both diffusion-path only.  They exist
# because the 2026-08-23 norm-cap smoke measured the per-step increment distributions and
# found the magnitude hypothesis false: B's increments are SMALLER than C's at every
# percentile up to p99 (p50 0.688x, mean 0.717x), and larger only at the extreme max.
# What differs is the count -- guidance fires on every step but the last, so 499 times per
# window on the diffusion path against 15 on the consistency path, giving 23.8x the total
# per-window displacement (499 x 46.54 = 23,225 against 15 x 64.94 = 974).
#
# hsi_guidance_dose_scale: a constant multiplier on the increment.  null = off.  1/23.8 =
# 0.04202 makes B's per-window total displacement equal C's, measured 975.8 vs C's 974.1.
#
# hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: multiply the increment by (1 - alpha_cumprod_t), the factor
# written and then commented out at the consistency-path guidance site.  alpha_cumprod
# rises to 1 as t falls to 0, so this SUPPRESSES guidance on the late low-noise refinement
# steps and keeps it on the early high-noise ones.  It is not equivalent to a constant
# scale: measured on the frozen worst-20 it takes the per-window total to 0.596x, i.e.
# 14.21x C rather than 23.84x, so it is a partial dose reduction with a schedule shape.
hsi_guidance_dose_scale: null
hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: false

# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gates on the per-window pelvis goal, both default to the
# CURRENT behaviour so every sealed cell stays bitwise reproducible.
#
# Training (datasets/infbagel.py:468-477) feeds pelvis_goal = joints[w0+45, 0] with
# y=0 for both the sit/lie and loco branches -- a per-window target.  The driver
# instead takes a point `hsi_lookahead_m` ahead along _straight_trajectory(), a
# straight chord from episode start to episode goal.  Measured distance from the
# driver's choice to training's target, over all 2271 windows:
#   walk 1099 windows: 1.0180 m mean (straight chord) vs 0.2124 m (GT pelvis path)
#   sit/lie 609      : 0.2012 m                       vs 0.1643 m
# and the GT pelvis advances only 0.478 m (walk) / 0.186 m (sit/lie) over those 45
# raw frames, against a hardcoded 0.8 m.  On a real wiggly path 0.8 m of ARC length
# nets ~0.48 m of displacement, so the constant is arc-length-calibrated; the chord
# makes arc length equal displacement, so it overshoots ~1.7x on walk.
# Evidence: .claude/scratch/isloco_offline_20260820/{goal_source_error.py,controls.py}
#
# hsi_gt_trajectory: true = build the lookahead path from the episode's GROUND-TRUTH
#   pelvis xz path instead of the chord.  Attribution UPPER BOUND only -- it feeds
#   privileged information a deployment cannot have.  Never use it for a baseline.
hsi_gt_trajectory: false
# hsi_lookahead_m: the lookahead arc length in metres.  0.8 is the released value.
#   0.48 is the deployable variant: one global constant, no privileged information.
hsi_lookahead_m: 0.8

shard_index: 0
shard_count: 1

# Serial latency pass.  Selects a deterministic scene-spanning episode subset
# sized by window budget; requires shard_count=1 so timing stays valid.
# 70 windows = 19 episodes over 18 of the 26 scenes; after the 5 warmup episodes
# that leaves 48 timed windows, i.e. ~47 min of measured guided-diffusion
# sampling at the measured 59.1 s/window (~68 min of total run wall clock).
latency_subset: false
latency_target_windows: 70

# lingo_hsi_mode=merge_shards inputs.  merge_shard_dir defaults to the parent
# directory the sharded runs wrote into; the expected totals are the full
# protocol and are the external anchor against a silently short merge.
merge_shard_dir: null
merge_expected_episodes: 375
merge_expected_windows: 2271
# 2026-08-18: default moved from `data/lingo_hsi_test/data` (v1) to v2. In v1
# `pelvis_goal` was the last frame of the FIRST 16-frame window, held fixed for
# the whole rollout, so start->goal was <= 0.778 m over all 375 episodes and the

lingo_episode_dir: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/data/lingo_hsi_test_v2/data
lingo_mesh_root: /data/yujinlun/datasets/LINGO/Scene_mesh
lingo_output_dir: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/results/lingo_hsi/${lingo_hsi_mode}-${sample_type}-${oc.select:use_guidance,false}
ckpt_path: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/checkpoint/checkpoint.pth
# When null, the evaluator uses the checkpoint file stem.
model_name: null
smplx_batch_size: 128

exp_name: lingo-hsi-eval
seed: 42
train: false
batch_size: 1
device: cuda:0
vis: false
start_type: stand

max_window_size: 16
auto_regre_num: 2
interp_s: 3
fps: 30.0

load_language: true
load_scene: true
load_scene_goal: true
load_pelvis_goal: true
load_object_goal: true
use_pi: true
use_random_frame_bps: false
use_object_keypoints: false
# Keep the sampler's shape-only object tensor alive for its settled occ_temp
# interface. The scene-only dataset wrapper never writes it into occupancy.
add_object_voxel: true

human_only_ratio: 0.4
lingo_scene_num: 111
lingo_data_ratio: 1.0
empty_omomo_scene: false
random_seed: 42

scene_type: occ_temp
temp_voxel_num: 3
w: 1
guidance_weight: 1
use_guidance: false
sample_type: consistency
timing_warmup_sequences: 5

# Opt-in motion export.  When false nothing is written beyond
# evaluation/per_sequence_metrics.json and that payload carries no
# motion_export key, so an export-capable build reproduces a pre-export payload
# byte for byte.  When true, motion/<sequence_id>.npz is written next to it with
# global_jpos at the rollout rate (fps = fps / interp_s) for the frozen
# text-motion evaluator, plus the SMPL-X FK inputs so a later metric
# redefinition is a CPU rebuild instead of another GPU run.
export_motion: false

lingo_hsi_mode: ground_truth
lingo_sequence_limit: null

# Episode sharding for the quality pass.  shard_count=1 is the serial protocol
# and is the default; >1 splits the canonical episode enumeration by greedy
# longest-first bin packing over per-episode window counts, and invalidates
# every timing aggregate because the shards contend for the host.
# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gate, default OFF so the sealed path is bitwise unchanged.
# test_infbagel_hosi.sample_step zeroes `pi` inside `if is_loco:` but leaves `end_pi`,
# so the model receives end_pi - pi = 42*step + 48 while training carries
# min(pi + 16*3, seq_len) i.e. exactly 48 on 517,484 of 529,132 need_pi windows.
# Only step 0 is training-legal: 375 of 2271 eval windows (16.5%).
# true = keep the true pi, restoring end_pi - pi == 48 on every window.
hsi_progress_fix: false

# hsi_guidance_norm_cap: per-step trust region on the guidance increment, applied on
# the DIFFUSION path only (Sampler.p_sample); the consistency path is untouched.
# null = off, and the arithmetic emitted is byte-identical to the released path -- no
# norm is computed and no extra tensor op runs.  A float caps the increment's PER-SAMPLE
# L2 norm: gradient *= min(1, cap / (||gradient|| + 1e-12)).
# It exists because the matched 2x2 of 2026-08-23 attributed 100% of the physically
# impossible root accelerations to guidance -- 132 frames over 5g in B v2 guided and 41
# in C v2 guided against 0 in both unguided cells -- and 80.2% of the summed effect
# magnitude on boundary_jerk to guidance-involving terms, with the interaction (64.401)
# the largest single term.  The released sampler adds the increment unnormalised once
# per sampler step, 499 times per window against the consistency path's 16.
# Units are those of the normalised 232-channel x_start, so a threshold is only
# meaningful relative to a measured increment distribution; see
# docs/plan/PHASE_1C_HSI.md 2026-08-23 SS-H.
hsi_guidance_norm_cap: null

# The two DOSE knobs, both off by default and both diffusion-path only.  They exist
# because the 2026-08-23 norm-cap smoke measured the per-step increment distributions and
# found the magnitude hypothesis false: B's increments are SMALLER than C's at every
# percentile up to p99 (p50 0.688x, mean 0.717x), and larger only at the extreme max.
# What differs is the count -- guidance fires on every step but the last, so 499 times per
# window on the diffusion path against 15 on the consistency path, giving 23.8x the total
# per-window displacement (499 x 46.54 = 23,225 against 15 x 64.94 = 974).
#
# hsi_guidance_dose_scale: a constant multiplier on the increment.  null = off.  1/23.8 =
# 0.04202 makes B's per-window total displacement equal C's, measured 975.8 vs C's 974.1.
#
# hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: multiply the increment by (1 - alpha_cumprod_t), the factor
# written and then commented out at the consistency-path guidance site.  alpha_cumprod
# rises to 1 as t falls to 0, so this SUPPRESSES guidance on the late low-noise refinement
# steps and keeps it on the early high-noise ones.  It is not equivalent to a constant
# scale: measured on the frozen worst-20 it takes the per-window total to 0.596x, i.e.
# 14.21x C rather than 23.84x, so it is a partial dose reduction with a schedule shape.
hsi_guidance_dose_scale: null
hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: false

# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gates on the per-window pelvis goal, both default to the
# CURRENT behaviour so every sealed cell stays bitwise reproducible.
#
# Training (datasets/infbagel.py:468-477) feeds pelvis_goal = joints[w0+45, 0] with
# y=0 for both the sit/lie and loco branches -- a per-window target.  The driver
# instead takes a point `hsi_lookahead_m` ahead along _straight_trajectory(), a
# straight chord from episode start to episode goal.  Measured distance from the
# driver's choice to training's target, over all 2271 windows:
#   walk 1099 windows: 1.0180 m mean (straight chord) vs 0.2124 m (GT pelvis path)

# raw frames, against a hardcoded 0.8 m.  On a real wiggly path 0.8 m of ARC length

# makes arc length equal displacement, so it overshoots ~1.7x on walk.
# Evidence: .claude/scratch/isloco_offline_20260820/{goal_source_error.py,controls.py}
#
# hsi_gt_trajectory: true = build the lookahead path from the episode's GROUND-TRUTH
#   pelvis xz path instead of the chord.  Attribution UPPER BOUND only -- it feeds
#   privileged information a deployment cannot have.  Never use it for a baseline.
hsi_gt_trajectory: false
# hsi_lookahead_m: the lookahead arc length in metres.  0.8 is the released value.
#   0.48 is the deployable variant: one global constant, no privileged information.
hsi_lookahead_m: 0.8

shard_index: 0
shard_count: 1

# Serial latency pass.  Selects a deterministic scene-spanning episode subset
# sized by window budget; requires shard_count=1 so timing stays valid.
# 70 windows = 19 episodes over 18 of the 26 scenes; after the 5 warmup episodes
# that leaves 48 timed windows, i.e. ~47 min of measured guided-diffusion

latency_target_windows: 70

# directory the sharded runs wrote into; the expected totals are the full
# protocol and are the external anchor against a silently short merge.
merge_shard_dir: null
merge_expected_episodes: 375
merge_expected_windows: 2271
# 2026-08-18: default moved from `data/lingo_hsi_test/data` (v1) to v2. In v1
# `pelvis_goal` was the last frame of the FIRST 16-frame window, held fixed for
# the whole rollout, so start->goal was <= 0.778 m over all 375 episodes and the
# 0.8 m lookahead in `sample_step` clamped on every window of every episode
# (measured 0/2271 unclamped). v2 sets the goal to the rollout terminus; GT then
# scores `last_dist` == 0. The four sealed model cells and every
# `results/lingo_hsi/ground_truth*` row except `ground-truth-v2`/`-v3` predate
# this and were run against v1 -- reproduce those with an explicit
# `lingo_episode_dir=${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/data/lingo_hsi_test/data` override.
lingo_episode_dir: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/data/lingo_hsi_test_v2/data
lingo_mesh_root: /data/yujinlun/datasets/LINGO/Scene_mesh
lingo_output_dir: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/results/lingo_hsi/${lingo_hsi_mode}-${sample_type}-${oc.select:use_guidance,false}
ckpt_path: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/checkpoint/checkpoint.pth
# When null, the evaluator uses the checkpoint file stem.
model_name: null
smplx_batch_size: 128

hydra:
  run:
    dir: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/.claude/scratch/hydra_lingo_hsi

hypothesis: D0b：C-v4 在 w=0 的无引导正式评估（375 episode, seed 42, shard_count=1, timing_valid）。检验连续 w 是否在冻结协议下产生有价值的、可替代外部几何 guidance 的控制。

scene_type: occ_temp

w: 1
guidance_weight: 1

sample_type: consistency

# Opt-in motion export.  When false nothing is written beyond

# byte for byte.  When true, motion/<sequence_id>.npz is written next to it with

# redefinition is a CPU rebuild instead of another GPU run.

lingo_hsi_mode: ground_truth

# Episode sharding for the quality pass.  shard_count=1 is the serial protocol

# longest-first bin packing over per-episode window counts, and invalidates
# every timing aggregate because the shards contend for the host.
# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gate, default OFF so the sealed path is bitwise unchanged.
# test_infbagel_hosi.sample_step zeroes `pi` inside `if is_loco:` but leaves `end_pi`,

# min(pi + 16*3, seq_len) i.e. exactly 48 on 517,484 of 529,132 need_pi windows.
# Only step 0 is training-legal: 375 of 2271 eval windows (16.5%).
# true = keep the true pi, restoring end_pi - pi == 48 on every window.

# null = off, and the arithmetic emitted is byte-identical to the released path -- no
# norm is computed and no extra tensor op runs.  A float caps the increment's PER-SAMPLE
# L2 norm: gradient *= min(1, cap / (||gradient|| + 1e-12)).
# It exists because the matched 2x2 of 2026-08-23 attributed 100% of the physically
# impossible root accelerations to guidance -- 132 frames over 5g in B v2 guided and 41
# in C v2 guided against 0 in both unguided cells -- and 80.2% of the summed effect
# magnitude on boundary_jerk to guidance-involving terms, with the interaction (64.401)
# the largest single term.  The released sampler adds the increment unnormalised once
# per sampler step, 499 times per window against the consistency path's 16.
# Units are those of the normalised 232-channel x_start, so a threshold is only
# meaningful relative to a measured increment distribution; see
# docs/plan/PHASE_1C_HSI.md 2026-08-23 SS-H.
hsi_guidance_norm_cap: null

# The two DOSE knobs, both off by default and both diffusion-path only.  They exist
# because the 2026-08-23 norm-cap smoke measured the per-step increment distributions and
# found the magnitude hypothesis false: B's increments are SMALLER than C's at every
# percentile up to p99 (p50 0.688x, mean 0.717x), and larger only at the extreme max.
# What differs is the count -- guidance fires on every step but the last, so 499 times per
# window on the diffusion path against 15 on the consistency path, giving 23.8x the total
# per-window displacement (499 x 46.54 = 23,225 against 15 x 64.94 = 974).
#
# hsi_guidance_dose_scale: a constant multiplier on the increment.  null = off.  1/23.8 =
# 0.04202 makes B's per-window total displacement equal C's, measured 975.8 vs C's 974.1.
#
# hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: multiply the increment by (1 - alpha_cumprod_t), the factor
# written and then commented out at the consistency-path guidance site.  alpha_cumprod
# rises to 1 as t falls to 0, so this SUPPRESSES guidance on the late low-noise refinement
# steps and keeps it on the early high-noise ones.  It is not equivalent to a constant
# scale: measured on the frozen worst-20 it takes the per-window total to 0.596x, i.e.
# 14.21x C rather than 23.84x, so it is a partial dose reduction with a schedule shape.

hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: false

# CURRENT behaviour so every sealed cell stays bitwise reproducible.

# Training (datasets/infbagel.py:468-477) feeds pelvis_goal = joints[w0+45, 0] with
# y=0 for both the sit/lie and loco branches -- a per-window target.  The driver
# instead takes a point `hsi_lookahead_m` ahead along _straight_trajectory(), a
# straight chord from episode start to episode goal.  Measured distance from the
# driver's choice to training's target, over all 2271 windows:

shard_count: 1

lingo_mesh_root: /data/yujinlun/datasets/LINGO/Scene_mesh

ckpt_path: ${oc.env:ROOT_DIR}/checkpoint/checkpoint.pth

# percentile up to p99 (p50 0.688x, mean 0.717x), and larger only at the extreme max.
# What differs is the count -- guidance fires on every step but the last, so 499 times per
# window on the diffusion path against 15 on the consistency path, giving 23.8x the total
# per-window displacement (499 x 46.54 = 23,225 against 15 x 64.94 = 974).
#
# hsi_guidance_dose_scale: a constant multiplier on the increment.  null = off.  1/23.8 =
# 0.04202 makes B's per-window total displacement equal C's, measured 975.8 vs C's 974.1.
#
# hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: multiply the increment by (1 - alpha_cumprod_t), the factor
# written and then commented out at the consistency-path guidance site.  alpha_cumprod
# rises to 1 as t falls to 0, so this SUPPRESSES guidance on the late low-noise refinement
# steps and keeps it on the early high-noise ones.  It is not equivalent to a constant
# scale: measured on the frozen worst-20 it takes the per-window total to 0.596x, i.e.
# 14.21x C rather than 23.84x, so it is a partial dose reduction with a schedule shape.
hsi_guidance_dose_scale: null
hsi_guidance_alpha_decay: false

# 2026-08-20 diagnostic gates on the per-window pelvis goal, both default to the
# CURRENT behaviour so every sealed cell stays bitwise reproducible.
#
# Training (datasets/infbagel.py:468-477) feeds pelvis_goal = joints[w0+45, 0] with
# y=0 for both the sit/lie and loco branches -- a per-window target.  The driver
# instead takes a point `hsi_lookahead_m` ahead along _straight_trajectory(), a
# straight chord from episode start to episode goal.  Measured distance from the
# driver's choice to training's target, over all 2271 windows:
#   walk 1099 windows: 1.0180 m mean (straight chord) vs 0.2124 m (GT pelvis path)
#   sit/lie 609      : 0.2012 m                       vs 0.1643 m
# and the GT pelvis advances only 0.478 m (walk) / 0.186 m (sit/lie) over those 45
# raw frames, against a hardcoded 0.8 m.  On a real wiggly path 0.8 m of ARC length
# nets ~0.48 m of displacement, so the constant is arc-length-calibrated; the chord
# makes arc length equal displacement, so it overshoots ~1.7x on walk.
# Evidence: .claude/scratch/isloco_offline_20260820/{goal_source_error.py,controls.py}
#
# hsi_gt_trajectory: true = build the lookahead path from the episode's GROUND-TRUTH

hsi_gt_trajectory: false

conclusion: NO RESULT IS CLAIMED. This row is a preregistration written before the formal run starts; nothing has been trained or evaluated under this experiment id. The arm's criteria, guardrails, tripwires, cost, evaluation plan, attribution cost and accepted INCONCLUSIVE outcomes are frozen in the dated P17-OC section of docs/plan/PHASE_1C_HSI.md before any formal GPU spend. Two preregistered clauses were amended AFTER seeing measurements and both amendments are recorded rather than absorbed: (1) pen_delta's decision rule literally required 0.1119 (GT's p95 fe_joint_max) and the user ruled 0.03 -- justified because the rule's stated REASON (do not penalise a pose GT itself adopts) rests on a binary intuition that a quadratic hinge does not share, measured: at delta=0.03 GT's own behaviour absorbs only 0.1604 of the model's quadratic pressure, a 6.2:1 asymmetry, while delta=0.1119 would leave 14 of the 44 target tail episodes (32%) under no pressure at all AND, decisively, would supply near-zero gradient at the converged stage (penetrating fraction of scorable triples: min 0.000%, median 0.154% at epoch222, i.e. at least one batch of 32 with exactly zero E3 gradient); (2) w_E3's cross-batch spread is 48.2x so three defensible estimators disagree by 1.64x (8.36 / 9.60 / 13.71) and the brief never specified which -- the user ruled ratio-of-means, 8.36, the correct estimator for a 10%-of-trunk-budget-on-average target. PRE-LAUNCH GATES, all CPU, all closed before this row: P.9 one-sidedness (free/contact points get EXACTLY 0.0 gradient, free_grad_exactly_zero true, against a two-sided sdf**2 control on the same points giving nonzero for all of them -- so zero-gradient is a property of the hinge's form, not of where the points sat); P.10 mirror path (2,540,000 occupancy comparisons over 127 scene pairs, 0 mismatches, indexed exactly as get_occ_for_points; SDF reflection commutes to 1.099e-06 m float32, 6e-5 of a voxel edge); P.12 basis match (E3 penalises 24 joints while the gate scores 10,475 vertices -- >20 cm tail linkage 44/44 = 1.0000 against a pre-frozen 1/2 threshold, frame-level mass reach 0.8564 against 1/3, and joint-only is 0/355 in every cell x basis x threshold, so E3 cannot be driven by a signal the gate cannot see); P.11 weight calibration on the trunk, not the global norm (91% of the global norm sits on 16 dead rows unrelated to the trunk). A GPU pre-check was ALSO run and is a hard gate on this row, not an optional extra: a 4000-step matched A/B at w_E3 8.36 and 8.36/3=2.79, user-approved 2026-08-28, reading root-attitude deviation from world +y on the model's own predicted rotation channel. It exists because this branch has a measured disaster of exactly this class -- loss_w_fk=50 drove predicted root attitude monotonically to 122.48 deg off world +y WHILE loss_fk itself kept falling, and E3 is the same kind of term, one reducible by translating or rotating the whole body. The veto rule was frozen before the numbers existed: veto iff the trajectory worsens monotonically AND ends above 15 deg (a conjunction -- the precedent's PASSING arm started at 125.2 deg and fell to 7.13, so either half alone would misjudge it), and the reader was falsification-checked against the precedent's own artifacts, where it must and does return VETOED for w=50 and PASSED for w=3 while reproducing every recorded digit. A/B RESULT, now in hand: BOTH legs PASSED and the decision is ADOPT 8.36. Endpoint pred_root_up_deg_p50 7.330 deg at w=8.36 and 7.564 at 2.79, against GT 7.954, with rank correlation -0.882 and -0.925 (the healthy sign; the vetoed precedent arm was +0.802) and last-quarter means 7.087 and 7.181 against the precedent passing arm's 6.966. Cross-rank spread at the endpoint 0.211 and 0.544 deg, so it is not a single-rank artifact, and the rise off the trajectory minimum -- the quantity the conjunction rule cannot see -- is 0.627 and 0.937 deg, negligible, so that reserved caveat did not bite. loss_pen fell 113x and 103x, so E3 is doing work in both legs rather than merely entering the graph. Matched start confirmed bitwise: at update 1 both legs have loss_pen 0.00592633243650198 and loss_fk 7.358377456665039 identical, and through update 6 the leg-to-leg difference tracks 8.36*pen - 2.79*pen to within 1e-6, so w_E3 is the single manipulated variable. The A/B also closed the resident-memory question in advance, for free: it ran at the formal arm's own layout and micro-batch, measuring 16,000-16,278 MiB of 24,576 per GPU, about 8.2 GB spare, 5.6x E3's 1.47 GB. TWO LIMITS recorded with the verdict rather than after it. First, the A/B's step time (~0.9 s) is NOT a valid reading for the formal run because two legs contend for CPU and dataloader bandwidth; that must still come from the formal run's own first 128 updates. Second, and more important, this PASS does not extrapolate to convergence: the loss_w_fk=50 disaster held 0.9991 of the gradient at update 1 and never fell below 0.94, which is why 4000 steps exposed it, whereas E3's share SHRINKS as it succeeds (measured 0.982 -> 0.487 at w=8.36 over the 4000 steps, on this probe's own denominator). 4000 steps is 2.7% of the budget. T0b therefore stays an abort gate at the first checkpoint and is NOT demoted to an observation -- a clause this preregistration had written the other way and has retracted.

config.content:
# Composed HOSI-test row -- both experts on one reverse chain.
#
# WHAT THIS ROW IS.  HOIPrior (Phase 1B settled: P15 + guidance Arm B) and HSIPrior
# generating together on the 469-episode HOSI-test benchmark, their x_hat_0 blended
# at every one of the 500 reverse steps by the preregistered gating operator, and
# scored by the same evaluator and the same 15 metrics as every other row on it.
#
# WHAT IT IS NOT.  A scene-blind row, and not a row whose HOI half is degraded:
# `code/astar.py:get_path` plans on the scene occupancy and the evaluator feeds a
# point on that path in as `pelvis_goal` at every window, for every row on this
# benchmark including G==0.  So the scene-awareness the HSI expert adds is on TOP of
# scene-aware waypoints, not instead of nothing -- which caps the headroom it can
# demonstrate here and must be stated wherever this row is cited.
#
# BASELINES (user's decision, 2026-08-29; docs/plan/PHASE_2_COMPOSITION.md).
#   primary     InfBaGel (paper) Hybrid, i.e. the 1:0.5 synth-OMOMO:LINGO model.
#               Published aggregate means only -- it cannot be paired, and it was
#               measured under the pre-repair representation.
#   reproducible G==0 P15+guide (p2-hosi-hoi-alone-g0-p15-guided-armb-s42-20260829).
#               The only row on this benchmark that is both reproducible and
#               PAIRABLE, so every significance test belongs against this one.
defaults:
  - config_sample_infbagel
  - _self_
  - override sampler:
      - hosi_composed

expert: composed

# Neither expert was distilled for this path: HOIPrior never was, and the composed
# chain has no consistency solver.  500 network calls per window per expert, so the
# latency of this row is not comparable to the released baseline's 16-step CM row.
# The user deferred inference latency until the composition works (2026-08-29).
sample_type: diffusion

# The EVALUATOR supplies no guidance_fn.  This does NOT mean the row is unguided:
# HOIPrior carries the preregistered Phase 1B P2 term on its sampler, and HSIPrior
# carries its own inference CFG (mixer_hsi_w).  Never infer either expert's
# guidance state from a run id or from this key.
use_guidance: false

load_scene: true

# HOI's expert deletes `object_points`; HSI's does not.  Under the evaluator's
# `cfg.vis = True` the temporal occupancy grids rebuild the object from
# `obj_rest_verts` regardless of this key, so it controls only the ANCHOR grid,
